avalancheActivity.highlights:
The Avalanche Warning Service currently has only a small amount of information that has been collected in the field.
The danger of natural avalanches will decrease gradually.
avalancheActivity.comment:
In particular from starting zones at higher altitudes large natural avalanches, capable of reaching the valleys, must be expected. Above approximately 2300 m they can be released in the new snow and wind slab layers.
The wind slabs will be deposited on unfavourable layers. They are to be assessed with care and prudence.
Single backcountry tourers can release avalanches.

snowpackStructure.comment:
Above approximately 2200 m there are 80 to 140 cm of snow, and even as much as 170 cm in some localities, especially above approximately 2600 m.
Several medium-sized dry avalanches have been released especially on very steep slopes.
As a consequence of the occasionally strong northwesterly wind, fresh snow drift accumulations formed on Sunday. The snowpack will become in some cases unstable.
Towards its base, the snowpack is moist, in particular below approximately 2300 m.

tendency.highlights: The risk of spontaneous avalanches will gradually decrease.

The Avalanche Warning Service currently has only a small amount of information that has been collected in the field.
The fresh snow as well as the wind slabs represent the main danger.
avalancheActivity.comment:
In particular from starting zones at higher altitudes large natural avalanches, capable of reaching low altitudes, must be expected. Above approximately 2300 m they can be released in the new snow and wind slab layers.
The wind slabs will be deposited on unfavourable layers. They and to be assessed with care and prudence.
Single backcountry tourers can release avalanches. Adjacent to ridgelines and in gullies and bowls and at the base of rock walls the likelihood of avalanches is higher.
